en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a wide curved sandy beach bordered by dense pine forest and low hills. The sea forms a gentle bay on the left, with scattered bathers visible on the shoreline. A lagoon or inlet appears to the right among the trees. In the lower margin there is printed bilingual text in Greek and English identifying the location, along with a website watermark and small printed numbers.
